_comment: Machine-readable summary of the TEBEOS-on-Linux findings. Vendor defaults are marked; change them in production.
_status_2026_10_14: Login automation WORKS. Post-login Medula menu/navigation BLOCKED: wine-gecko 2.47 = Firefox 47 cannot run SGK's hxclient JS (menu sub-items blank; 'Medula'da Ac' -> E-Recete Giris fails). User confirmed Medula works in modern Chromium/Firefox and CHOSE PATH A: Wine-level 'IE->CEF' shim re-hosting the IE WebBrowser control onto the bundled CEF/Chromium (which already runs under Wine; CDP RemoteDebuggingPort 8080 is already set). Vendor EXEs stay untouched -> survives weekly updates. See HANDOFF-PATH-A.md (canonical for the engine pivot).

app.name: TEBEOS Plus
app.vendor: Türk Eczacılar Birliği (TEB) - Turkish Pharmacists' Association.  NOTE: KolaySoft is NOT the TEBEOS vendor - it makes the cash-register software TEBEOS talks to (the DB has a 'yazarkasa' schema for it).
app.embedded_browser: CefSharp / CEF (libcef.dll) + WebView2 files; used to drive SGK 'Medulla'

database.engine: PostgreSQL 12.4 (Windows x64 build, bundled by the vendor, runs under Wine)

ini_file.encoding_trap: code reads section 'CONNECTİON' with Turkish dotted capital I (U+0130); vendor ships '[CONNECTION]' with ASCII I -> lookup misses -> empty IP -> crash. Write both UTF-8 (C4 B0) and CP1254 (DD) variants.

keys.BAGLANTI.CLIENT: TRUE = this PC is a terminal/client, FALSE = this PC is the main computer

known_bugs.effect: FormatException 'An invalid IP address was specified' at start-up
known_bugs.fix: use the Turkish dotted I in the section name (both encodings)

known_bugs.effect: returns true even when the TCP connect is refused (treats async completion as success)
known_bugs.fix: cannot patch vendor binary; avoid the empty-IP state

known_bugs.effect: lc_messages/lc_monetary/lc_numeric/lc_time = 'tr_TR.UTF-8' (Linux locale names) -> Windows PostgreSQL refuses to start
/VERYSILENT aborts with 'Failed to proceed to next wizard page'
exits immediately under Wine, does nothing

WINEDLLOVERRIDES='mscoree,mshtml=' has an EMPTY load order = disabled -> Wine: 'mscoree.dll not found', 'IL-only binary tebeos_plus.exe cannot be loaded', exit 53; also makes the script's own 30s test launch fail with an empty testlaunch.log
known_bugs.fix: use WINEDLLOVERRIDES='mscoree=n' and leave mshtml ENABLED (see id 9) -- mscoree must be native, and the env var overrides winetricks' registry '*mscoree=native'

known_bugs.effect: the INI is written through the ANSI profile API; Wine takes that codepage from the HOST LOCALE (registry ACP is ignored). On an en_US host the codepage is 1252, which has no 'g-with-breve', so best-fit mapping stores 'gu' where the user typed 'g-breve u' -> the remembered password is refused and must be retyped every time
known_bugs.fix: run the app with LC_ALL=tr_TR.UTF-8 (codepage 1254); the installer auto-detects a Turkish locale and puts it in the launcher. Verified: remembered password logs in with no typing

known_bugs.where: Wine's bundled fonts (tahoma.ttf, tahomabd.ttf, arial.ttf) and the fonts winetricks installs
known_bugs.effect: no U+20BA TURKISH LIRA SIGN -> every money amount in the UI is drawn as '1.234,56' + tofu box (the corefonts/tahoma winetricks ships are XP-era and lack it too)
known_bugs.fix: fonts/ in this repo holds Wine's three files with the glyph grafted in; patch-wine-fonts.py grafts it in place into the prefix's real Tahoma/Arial (donor Noto Sans rescaled to the target units-per-em, so metrics/family names are unchanged). The installer does both; originals kept in <wine>/share/wine/fonts/orig/

known_bugs.effect: window opens with its toolbar but the content pane stays blank: ieframe never creates an HTML document and mshtml.dll is never loaded
known_bugs.fix: MSHTML's classes were missing from the 32-BIT registry view (Software\Classes\Wow6432Node\CLSID). Install wine-gecko 2.47.4 (x86 + x86_64) and run 'regsvr32 /s C:\windows\syswow64\mshtml.dll'; keep mshtml ENABLED. Verified: the SGK Medula login page renders

known_bugs.effect: 'fonts look off': TEBEOS asks for 'System' ~9000x per session and Wine resolves unknown families through fontconfig -> it came back as Noto Sans while 'Tahoma' was Wine's own clone, so the UI mixed two typefaces
known_bugs.fix: install real Windows fonts (winetricks corefonts tahoma) and add the substitution 'System' -> 'Tahoma'; the installer does both

known_bugs.where: Medula login - the captcha ('Guvenlik Anahtari') field
known_bugs.effect: the field swallows EVERY keystroke, so the Medula login can never be completed. The page runs `if (event.keyCode < 48 || event.keyCode > 57) event.returnValue = false;` and Wine's MSHTML returns keyCode=0 for keypress (Gecko fills keyCode only for keydown/keyup; wine-gecko 2.47.4 = Firefox 47 predates the 2018 charCode->keyCode mirroring), so 0<48 and every key is cancelled
known_bugs.fix: FIXED with a rebuilt mshtml.dll (wine-patch/ in this repo; install-tebeos-client.sh applies it): 5 lines in dlls/mshtml/htmlevent.c make DOMKeyboardEvent_get_keyCode() use the character code for keypress when Gecko reports 0 - what IE does and what Chrome/Firefox have done since 2018. Verified with a minimal page under wine iexplore: before, the field swallowed input and the handler saw keyCode=0; after, the field accepts input and the handler sees keyCode=51. Build recipe: wine-patch/README.md (llvm-mingw, no root). The app's own automation was always fine - it fills user, password and ticks the KVKK box

wine_environment.tested: Wine 11.2 Staging (Lutris runner build) on CachyOS
wine_environment.verified_again: 2026-09-30 on CachyOS, Wine 11.18 staging (Kron4ek wow64), client/terminal role against a live server on the LAN (db.vers 1.4.1.2): login window reached

_stale_fields.note: the values below were true for the first machine; the 2026-09-30 client observed newer ones
_stale_fields.login_screen_roles: three radio options: Bu Bilgisayar / Ana Bilgisayar / Terminal

windows_server_requirement: allow inbound TCP 5454; give the PC a static IP / DHCP reservation

medula.window_technology: NOT CefSharp for this window -- a legacy Microsoft Web Browser (Internet Explorer) ActiveX control, i.e. Wine's ieframe, rendered by MSHTML + wine-gecko (Gecko = Firefox's engine)
medula.symptom_under_wine: window opens with its toolbar, content pane stays blank
medula.root_cause: MSHTML's classes were missing from the 32-bit registry view, so ieframe could not create an HTML document and mshtml.dll was never loaded (wine-gecko alone changed nothing)
medula.fix: install wine-gecko 2.47.4 (x86 + x86_64, the version this Wine build asks for), then regsvr32 /s C:\windows\syswow64\mshtml.dll and keep mshtml enabled. Both steps are in install-tebeos-client.sh. Verified: the SGK Medula login page renders
medula.engine_caveat: Wine has no Trident (real IE); Gecko 2.47 = Firefox 47 (2016) is the substitute, so individual screens may render differently than under real IE
medula.e_imza: not needed for pharmacists (that is the physicians' side of Medula); the app only probes for ArkSigner/ArkSignerBEs
medula.captcha_field: BLOCKED on Wine: the captcha field swallows every keystroke (see bug 11), so the login cannot be completed from the app under Wine. Not an app bug - Wine's MSHTML reports keyCode=0 for keypress and SGK's onlyNumbers() filter cancels anything outside 48..57
medula.still_untested: everything after the login: whether the vendor's IE-style DOM automation drives the site correctly on Gecko

open_items: backup/restore round-trip (Yedek Al / Geri Yukle) not tested

online update flow: on 2026-09-30 the app updated itself (project 1.2.9.9 -> 1.3.1.8) but logged '23505 duplicate key ... exeversion_version_key' and a Wine COM/WMI error in GuncellemeLog/Tebeos_2026.09.30.log
Medula beyond the login page: how far the vendor's automation gets on Gecko 2.47 (vs Trident) is untested
